description: Default seed data for the Dhriti Enterprises business tracker. Browser edits are stored separately until backend persistence is implemented.

stages.name: Raw Makhana Sourcing
stages.desc: Identify and qualify top-quality raw phool makhana.
tasks: Define quality and size grades
Request samples from at least 3 suppliers
Inspect moisture, colour, broken pieces and roasting quality

stages.name: Trader Discussion & Price Finalization
stages.desc: Compare trader quotations and agree supply and payment terms.
tasks: Contact raw makhana traders
Compare prices, grade, MOQ and delivery charges
Negotiate price and payment terms
Select supplier and document agreed terms

stages.name: Warehouse & Premises Setup
stages.desc: Finalize suitable premises and prepare a hygienic production and storage area.
tasks: Finalize premises or warehouse
Check electricity, ventilation, water and pest control
Plan raw-material, production and finished-goods zones

stages.name: Machinery Selection
stages.desc: Select equipment for multiple packet sizes and multiple products.
tasks: Contact Hayat Engineering Works and comparable suppliers
Get quotations for powder filling and multi-size packing
Confirm sealing, weighing, speed, power and service support
Evaluate nitrogen flushing and compatible packaging

stages.name: Makhana Processing & Flavouring
stages.desc: Finalize roasting/popping, seasoning and masala-mixing process.
tasks: Contact makhana popping/roasting machine suppliers
Evaluate seasoning tumbler or masala mixing machine
Trial salted and flavoured recipes
Document process settings and cleaning procedure

stages.name: Licences & Compliance
stages.desc: Complete applicable food-business and packaged-commodity compliance.
tasks: Confirm appropriate FSSAI registration/licence
Check Legal Metrology and local permissions
Prepare compliant product labels
Arrange batch/date/expiry coding machine
Plan product safety and shelf-life testing

stages.name: Packaging Suppliers
stages.desc: Source food-grade customized pouches, sachets and zipper bags.
tasks: Contact at least 3 packaging suppliers
Confirm food-contact suitability and barrier properties
Compare plain pouches versus custom-printed MOQ
Confirm zipper options, lead times and delivery

stages.name: Brand Name & Packaging Design
stages.desc: Finalize brand identity, pack sizes, artwork and compliant label copy.
tasks: Finalize brand name and check availability
Finalize logo and visual identity
Approve ₹5/₹10 sachet and makhana pouch designs
Proofread mandatory declarations before printing

stages.name: Samples & Quality Testing
stages.desc: Produce pilot batches and validate taste, weight, seals and shelf life.
tasks: Produce pilot batch of each selected SKU
Check net weight, seal integrity and taste
Arrange suitable product and shelf-life tests
Collect feedback and approve final recipes

stages.name: Market Launch & Distribution
stages.desc: Launch locally, then expand to marketplaces and quick commerce.
tasks: Prepare retailer price list and sales kit
Distribute samples to local shops and malls
Record feedback and first orders
Prepare Amazon listings and assess quick-commerce onboarding
